Changes and errata

Version 2.2

  • Dark colours when the reader's system is set to dark mode; printing is unchanged.
  • Faster start on slow machines: calculators and self-checks start as soon as the text has loaded, without waiting for figures.
  • New editions built from the same source: EPUB for e-readers, a typeset PDF, and a flashcard file for Anki.
  • Version number and this page.

Version 2.1

  • Every chapter and appendix rewritten for second-year undergraduates: terms defined at first use, numbered equations with symbol lists, worked examples in four parts, section checks, misconception boxes, index of terms and notation page.

Version 2.0

  • Chapters 2A, 2B and 6 added; all chapters expanded with worked examples, labs, problems with solutions, figures and references; Appendices A to E added.

Errata

None reported. Send corrections to the address in the licence, with the page and the paragraph.
